protocol_stage: premeasurement registration; do not inspect ROC06 intervention effects before freeze

parent.immutable_model: original ROC05A first hosted run; all twelve model SHA must match; no refitting
parent.original_architecture: QueryConditionedTableMemory 51520 parameters width128 depth8, fixed prequery memory, 4+4 tied residual suffix

source.train_pools: only ROC05A arm-matched 1024 original train rows to construct gradient and supervised bases
source.development: same exposed 256 ROC05A development cases as ROC05B; all cases, no case selection
source.legal_counterfactual: swap initial source A table outputs at queried q and (q+4)%8, preserving delay, distractors and final query; verify symbolic labels
source.roc05_reserved: 384 reserved table IDs stay identities only; never generate inputs, inspect labels or score
source.roc04_previous_rules: 1152 consumed ROC04 identities excluded by ROC05A source code
source.source_checks: recompute original train and dev JSONL byte SHA and all checkpoint hashes before fitting observers or evaluating

gradient_basis.location: prequery midpoint after all events except last visible query and first four of eight tied residual steps
gradient_basis.suffix: remaining four tied residual updates and original table_head selected by fixed final one-hot query
gradient_basis.target: for each of 1024 train examples, legal row swap changes y to yprime; calculate d/dh_mid [z_native(yprime)-z_native(y)] evaluated at unedited train midpoint
gradient_basis.compute: analytic four-step tied tanh suffix reverse-mode VJP, verified against PyTorch autograd and centered-difference directional derivatives before real data
gradient_basis.normalize: normalize each finite nonzero 128-dimensional train gradient to unit L2 (epsilon 1e-10 for invalid-state rejection); subtract train gradient mean; take top seven right singular vectors of 1024x128 centered normalized gradients
gradient_basis.rank_gate: 7th singular value > 1e-9; orthonormality max |U' U-I| <=1e-7; any failure abort cell
gradient_basis.avoid_selection: one basis per frozen model, constructed using train rows and true train labels only; no dev-based penalty, rank or gamma selection; fix sign by projecting actual source edit delta
gradient_basis.reference: ROC05B identical train-only supervised cross-covariance rank-7 observer from mean-centered train midpoints and queried correct label onehot, no optimizer updates
gradient_basis.exploratory_geometry: train-only PCA rank7 baseline and 128 SHA-keyed rank7 random nulls per each of two fixed exposed shadow states; D=T-I and H capture as in ROC05B, six one-sided tails plus Holm
gradient_basis.relevant_question: whether a task-gradient-informed low-rank observer captures more useful causal changed-rule directions than task label covariance

interventions.location: same ROC05B native midpoint and original frozen suffix/readout
directions: gradient_observed P_grad delta normalized to r
supervised_observed P_sup delta normalized to r
input_soft early-A feature interpolation with hidden midpoint radius r
full hidden source delta normalized to r
interventions.input_interpolation: same ROC05B fixed 64-grid first crossing and 24 bisections, error <=2e-5; off-manifold input has no independently valid source label
interventions.normalizer: absolute 128-dimensional midpoint L2 radius, the same original h0 and same original suffix
interventions.full_legal: report valid discrete rule edit and new-label correctness at its natural, potentially larger physical dose

primary.per_case: g(gradient-observed rank7, r=.20), g(supervised-observed rank7, r=.20), and g(softened-input r=.20) evaluated on the same valid pair
primary.per_seed: mean over all cases eligible in all three routes; d_s=mean_g_gradient - max(mean_g_supervised, mean_g_soft_input) in original frozen-model target margin units
primary.scientific_null: gradient observer fails to exceed at least one preregistered comparator on fixed exposed dev pool
primary.acceptance: >=80% three-way eligible dev cases per seed; at least 5/6 positive d_s; positive unweighted six-seed mean; one-sided exact six-seed 64-sign p <=0.05
primary.if_unreachable: ABSTAIN if any seed <205/256 triple-eligible, report gate and per-route missed cases explicitly; no replacement labels
primary.analysis_unit: six frozen independent model initializations; exposed dev cases are within-seed paired, not new independent model samples
primary.multiplicity: single registered max-of-two mean comparator controls both reference arms at seed level; secondary pairwise tests descriptive, no posthoc choosing winner
primary.selection_scope: preexisting ROC05A/ROC05B dev results were known; ROC06 exploratory dev-family mechanistic optimization, no fresh-rule confirmation

geometry: frozen true discrete source-rule changed-target correctness
secondary.report: all per-case routes and dose validity flags, twelve checkpoint source hashes, per-model training-gradient singular values, 128-null raw records and 3,072 nulls if all 12 models, six-seed conservative maximum-comparator effects, exact sign flip

compute: CPU PyTorch 2.10; single-thread per model; no optimizer updates, no paid GPU
stop: different labels between legal edit and exact interpreter
any ROC05 reserved or ROC02 original sealed source example read
conclusion_scope: A success only supports this exposed-development causal contrast for this train-derived rank7 basis, not a complete ROC01 mechanism classification; failure is negative evidence specific to the registered rank, horizon and endpoint.
